Harry Styles wrote "Coming Up Roses" as a Christmas song, then dropped the idea after two lines. Now it's racing the real Christmas songs on Spotify.

Week to Nov 12: Coming Up Roses No.26 with 14.7M global streams, ahead of Mariah Carey's "All I Want for Christmas Is You" (No.31, 14.1M) and just behind Wham!'s "Last Christmas" (No.19, 15.8M). By the Nov 17 daily chart, both classics had passed it: No.10 and No.17 vs No.36.

The song is the fourth single (Oct 30, 2026) from Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally.

Does Coming Up Roses survive Christmas season?

Data: Spotify charts via kworb · Nov 12-17, 2026
